name: AssemblyAI
summary: Transcription API with diarisation and LLM-powered follow-up features, pitched at product teams.
description:
AssemblyAI is the pragmatic middle: an accurate-enough general transcription API with speaker diarisation, custom vocabulary and a layer of summarisation and question-answering over the transcript. For meeting notes, interview research and call QA you can usually ship the feature without owning a model, which is the point.

Its own AI features are the thing to be careful with — a summary of a summary inherits errors, so anything that ends up in front of a customer needs the transcript kept alongside it. If the workload is live rather than batch, or a specific language is central, compare against a provider strong in that dimension instead of assuming one vendor covers both.
